title: It Leaks !!!!
text: It Leaks !!!!. I have had this less than a month ago , My hubby bought it for me due to me having Gastric surgery and I can not use a straw. Well the lid I need is leaking pretty bad. I am so disappointed as the liquid stays very cold ,but I can not use the lid at all. I even reached out to the company and they have not even returned an email at all. Way to stand behind your product!!!

product_metadata.title: FineDine Insulated Water Bottles with Straw - 32 Oz Stainless Steel Metal Water Bottle W/ 3 Lids - Reusable for Travel, Camping, Bike, Sports - Fresh White Marble
features: TRIPLE INSULATION: Our thermoses are crafted with triple insulation to keep your drinks hot for up to 12 hours and cold for up to 24 hours! Say goodbye to lukewarm drinks and hello to refreshing sips all day long.

VERSATILE LIDS: Our drinking bottle comes with three individual lids to serve all your needs. Use the one with the mouthpiece for sipping hot drinks, the one with the straw for cold beverages, and the removable lid for drinks containing ice or fruit.

DURABLE DESIGN: Our bottle is leak-proof and shatter-proof, making it the perfect choice for rough-and-tumble use. It's safe in backpacks, beach bags, or on the edge of your countertop. Plus, it's dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.

TRAVEL-FRIENDLY: A built-in handle enables you to carry it with ease or attach it to a backpack, and the large capacity makes it perfect for when you're on the go. Take it with you on hikes, bike rides, camping trips, or to the gym.

HEALTHY AND ECO-FRIENDLY: Our water bottles are made of superior 18/8 stainless steel, free of BPA or any other toxins. They last an average of 12 years and won't grow mold or retain previous flavors. Make the switch from plastic to stainless and protect the environment and your health.
